title: Mushrooms when the rain comes
odia:
ଛି ଲୋ ଛତୁ,
ମେଘ ବରଷିଲେ କେତେ ତୁ ଫୁଟୁ।
literal_meaning: Tut, mushroom! How you sprout when the clouds rain!
meaning_odia: ଛତୁକୁ ଉପହାସ କରି କୁହାଯାଉଛି—ମେଘ ବରଷିଲେ ତୁ କେତେ ଫୁଟୁ! ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଅନୁକୂଳ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ମିଳିବାମାତ୍ରେ କାହାର ଅତି ଉତ୍ସାହ ବା ବଢ଼ିଚଢ଼ି ଆଚରଣକୁ ଏହି ଚିତ୍ରରେ ଥଟ୍ଟା କରିହୁଏ। ଛି ଶବ୍ଦଟି ଏହାକୁ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ଅପେକ୍ଷା ତାଚ୍ଛଲ୍ୟର ସ୍ୱର ଦିଏ।
explanation: The speaker addresses a mushroom as though it could hear a rebuke. Rain arrives, and its sprouting becomes something to mock. Our editorial reading is a taunt at exuberance encouraged by favourable circumstances. The inspected dictionary counterpart supports the reproachful tone, while using a different final verb.
usage_example: Original imagined example: After receiving a little encouragement, someone suddenly dominates every discussion. A friend jokingly compares that burst of activity to the mushroom that sprouts when rain arrives.
cultural_context: The rhyme pairs ଛତୁ with ଫୁଟୁ, turning the mushroom’s appearance after rain into a sharp direct address. The opening ଛି sets the speaker’s dismissive tone before the image unfolds.
